notes:
Inbound lead from web signup + Product Hunt reply. Small but growing helpdesk startup rebuilding inbox automation. Primary ask: hosted API sandbox to prototype ticket summarization + structured JSON output to populate our ticket fields (priority, category, suggested SLA action). Also wants tool-calling patterns: KB lookup, ticket-merge, and suggested canned responses. 

Key constraints/requirements: public cloud only for now (no VPC), latency target ~150-300ms p50 for short summaries, throughput ~8-12 reqs/sec expected during business hours. Cost sensitivity flagged repeatedly — 'we're early stage, must keep per-ticket cost < $0.02 if possible with batching and caching'. Prefers open models or Redwood-verified small/quantized models; needs fallback policy to cheaper model during spikes. 

Security: requires SSO (SAML) for internal users, audit logging and data retention controls. Not yet requiring SOC2 but expects maturity in 12-18 months. They asked about KMS and whether tokens are stored – AE clarified hosted API does not persist customer content beyond retention policy unless enabled.
